propositions: Outbound CREATE mutations lack prerequisite metadata (requires_create, requires_parent) because OutboundCreatePayload has no prerequisite fields and current emission path loses metadata before planner receives it

Batch sequencer lacks create-ordering capability: create_route.should_hold_dependent has no production caller and batch_dispatch.reroute_migrated_plans explicitly excludes creates, forcing ordering through a new per-pass scheduler
Prerequisites must use local ticket IDs exclusively and never invent Jira keys for unbound parents; planner dependency resolution requires Mutation.target == TicketPlan.identity

Create-scheduler must dispatch eligible plans through existing apply_handlers.handle_create and create_route, releasing dependents only on confirmed parent containment and deferring on permanent failure, commit_unknown, budget-defer, or unconfirmed outcomes

Batch and typed create adapters must expose identical create-route completion signals (confirmed/dependents_released) without dual dispatch or second route selector, preserving single create_route ownership of persistence and rollback
